description: Dedicated HGRApi tool for POST api/AI/PublishNow. This is an explicit tool with a fixed endpoint; it is not a generic endpoint caller. HGRApi functional documentation: Purpose: Queues an existing AI proposal for publication to its exact store product. ownerAgent: optimization. Use when: Use after reviewing and accepting a stored proposal. Input: Header channel, TaskId, ListingId (ListingVariation ID). For Fields, optional FieldNames selects a nonempty subset of stored proposed changes; omit to apply all. New field values cannot be supplied through this endpoint. Output: Returns Success after authorizing and queueing the proposal. Identity, category and current field values are rechecked before applying. No API waits for confirmed saved values before marking published. Search terms: ai publishnow. Send the exact request payload in body. Requires confirmed=true and impactConfirmed=true before execution. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

channelOAuthId.description: ChannelOAuthId returned by hgr_list_channels for the selected visible store.

confirmed.description: Must be true after the user explicitly requested or confirmed the exact action.

impactConfirmed.description: Must be true after the user explicitly confirmed the concrete high-impact consequences.

name: hgr_post_ai_publishnow
title: Post Ai Publishnow
